title: polyEval is additive: evaluating a coefficientwise sum equals the sum of the evaluations
statement: CReal.Equiv (polyEval (polyAdd c g) n x) (polyEval c n x + polyEval g n x) -- polyEval distributes over polyAdd, for every coefficient functions c, g, degree bound n, and point x.

formal.statement: theorem CReal.polyEval_polyAdd : ((x0 : ((x0 : AxNat) -> CReal)) -> ((x1 : ((x1 : AxNat) -> CReal)) -> ((x2 : AxNat) -> ((x3 : CReal) -> CReal.Equiv (CReal.polyEval (CReal.polyAdd x0 x1) x2 x3) (CReal.add (CReal.polyEval x0 x2 x3) (CReal.polyEval x1 x2 x3))))))

evidence.supports: CReal.polyEval_polyAdd is admitted by the trusted kernel gate with the type recorded in formal.statement.
evidence.checker_command: cargo run -q --release -p axeyum-lean-kernel --example theorem_dependency_inventory -- CReal.polyEval_polyAdd 2>/dev/null | grep -cE '^CReal\.polyEval_polyAdd[[:space:]]'
